title: Prostate Cancer Prediction
description: Prediction of prostate cancer likelihood using regression models trained on clinical and biological attributes, with interpretability via feature importance analysis.
context: Doctors and researchers need early indicators of prostate cancer risk from clinical data.
projectDescription: Built regression models on patient datasets to estimate cancer probability and highlight relevant biomarkers.
challengesSolutions: Correlated variables → used regularization to improve stability
resultsImpact: Produced interpretable models to identify key clinical risk factors.
learningsTakeaways: Gained experience handling medical data and balancing accuracy with interpretability.

title: Geographic Classification of Individuals
description: Classification of individuals by geographic origin using demographic and genetic features, combined with PCA visualization and supervised learning.
context: Researchers needed to group individuals by geographic region based on high-dimensional features.
projectDescription: Built a dimensionality reduction and classification pipeline using PCA and SVM/KNN.
roleContributions: Trained classifiers (SVM, KNN) on reduced data
challengesSolutions: High dimensionality → PCA for variance preservation
Class overlap → optimized hyperparameters for SVM kernels
resultsImpact: Achieved 88% classification accuracy and provided clear PCA-based visual insights.
learningsTakeaways: Learned to combine unsupervised dimensionality reduction with supervised classifiers.

title: Scikit-learn Library Contribution
description: Open-source contribution to the Scikit-learn machine learning library, improving documentation and minor functionality.
context: Scikit-learn community needed bug fixes and clearer documentation for new users.
projectDescription: Contributed to the open-source ML ecosystem by improving Scikit-learn features and docs.
roleContributions: Fixed bugs and improved function consistency
Collaborated on GitHub pull requests with maintainers
challengesSolutions: Community reviews → iterated on PRs based on feedback
resultsImpact: Merged contributions that improved usability for thousands of Scikit-learn users.
learningsTakeaways: Learned open-source collaboration workflow and importance of clean, documented code.
